title: Series tracker (_data/series/*.yml)
description: One file per series. Backlog entries live under entries:, sub-series under groups:. Articles link via meta.series in post front matter -- never duplicate an article as an entry.

name.description: Canonical series name. Must match meta.series in posts exactly.

icon.description: Media emoji shown before the name. Omit if the series spans several media.

tag.description: Legacy field from the tag era. Unused by templates, do not add to new files.

description.description: Blurb shown above the entries list on the series page. HTML allowed.

entries.description: Backlog items (no article yet). Entries duplicating an article are auto-excluded -- delete them. Also renders first as the ungrouped block when groups: exist.

groups.description: Sub-series, rendered in definition order after ungrouped items. Refs are full titles, matched emoji/case-insensitive. First match wins.

title.description: Sub-series heading, e.g. Arc Liberl, La saga X, Spin-offs.

entries.description: Full item titles (posts or backlog entries).

title.description: Item title. Emoji optional (kept as-is for entries, e.g. per-medium icons).

platform.description: Console for the icon, or Film / TV / Livre. Optional -- omit for plain text (recommended for books). Unknown values fall back to a gamepad icon.

release_date.description: Original release date, YYYY-MM-DD. Used for display and date sorting.

finished_date.description: Date you finished it (YYYY-MM-DD), or true = finished on an unknown date (shows ?). Counts toward the done badge.

rating.description: Your 0-5 rating, shown in the ★ column.

dropped.description: true = abandoned/refused. Shown gray, excluded from the done badge math so it never blocks 100%.

meta.description: Legacy sub-hash (imdb, wikipedia...). NEVER read for entries -- omit.
